# Specialist Movers

> Auckland and Hamilton's premium moving company. House, piano, commercial, packing, storage, and exit cleaning. Founded 2023. Hundreds of 5-star Google reviews.

Specialist Movers (KB Logistics Limited) runs from bases in Auckland (Wairau Valley) and Hamilton. We service Auckland, the Waikato, and wider North Island moves. Trusted by Steinway and major Auckland music stores for piano relocations.

## Services

- House and home relocations (viewing-first quotes)
- Piano moving (upright, grand, storage, international shipping)
- Office and commercial relocations (SiteWise Gold certified)
- Professional packing (crew packs the day before move day)
- Exit cleaning (fixed-price tenancy cleans)
- Loading and unloading
- Hard-to-shift items (spa pools, safes, heavy furniture)
- WINZ moving quotes (written quotes for assistance applications)
- Short-term, long-term, overnight, and in-transit storage
- International moving (sea and air freight)
